annotations.title: Can a foreign resident in Japan work this part-time job or side gig on their status, and which permission is needed?

description: Applies the Immigration Services Agency's rules on permission for activities outside status of residence (資格外活動許可, Immigration Control Act art. 19(2); rules as of 2026-10-26). Comprehensive permission (包括許可) for Student, Dependent and Designated Activities (dependent / job hunting): 28 hours in any 7 days, all jobs combined; students 8 h/day in the school's official long vacation; never at 風俗営業 / 特定遊興飲食店 / sex-related venues in any role. NEW 2026-10-01: Dependent (家族滞在) holders only may work at pachinko, mahjong and licensed game centers (風営法 2条1項4号・5号) with an individual permission per venue (employer + applicant pledges, venue license copy, ≤ 28 h total); students still excluded. Contractor delivery counts only if hours are objectively verifiable; freelance with unclear hours needs individual permission; company/staff/office needs Business Manager. Work visas: same-field OK, other work status needs individual permission, simple labor generally not allowed. SSW, Technical Intern, Temporary Visitor: no side jobs; Working Holiday free except 風俗営業; PR/spouse/long-term resident unrestricted. Returns verdict (ok | ok_if_hours | apply_first | individual_permission | status_change | not_allowed | no_restriction), headline, summary, permissionNeeded, hours {weeklyLimit, dailyLimitOnVacation, withinLimit, rolling windows}, conditions, documents, steps, warnings, ISA sources, disclaimer. Use for 'can I work on a student visa', 留学生 アルバイト 28時間, 家族滞在 パチンコ, Uber Eats on a visa. Educational, not immigration advice; not affiliated with ISA.

dailyHours.description: Day-by-day hours, comma separated, all jobs combined; suffix v = school long-vacation day (students only), e.g. '8v,8v,8v,4,4,0,0'. Checks every rolling 7-day window.

enrolled.description: Students: still enrolled and attending. Default true.

hasEmployeesOrOffice.description: Freelance: hires staff, has a company or rents an office.

internshipEligible.description: Students: final-year undergrad with ~90%+ credits, final-year master's/PhD, or credit-bearing practicum.

job.description: Kind of work or venue. izakaya_bar = no hosting of guests; hostess_bar = hosting (接待) venues incl. snack/girls bar; delivery_gig = app contractor (Uber Eats etc.); internship = over 28 h/week.

longVacation.description: Students: hours fall in the school's official long vacation (8 h/day rule).

permission.description: Permission already held. comprehensive = 28-hour stamp on the residence card. Default unknown.

sameCategoryWork.description: Work visa: side job is the same kind of work the visa covers.

status.description: Status of residence. student = 留学; dependent = 家族滞在; designated_dependent / job_hunting = 特定活動; work_visa = 技人国, 教育, 教授 etc.; specified_skilled = 特定技能; technical_intern = 技能実習; temporary_visitor = tourist; unrestricted = permanent resident, spouse of Japanese/PR, long-term resident.

weeklyHours.description: Hours in a 7-day period across ALL side jobs.
